baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled ق ر ض at words 2 and 4 is qualified by ح س ن and answered by ض ع ف.
baseline_models.mechanism: The giver cuts a possessed portion away as returnable capital; beneficent quality makes the severance more than bare exchange, and the response enlarges rather than merely replaces it.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and separating supplies the initial detachment of a possessed portion.
Advancing wealth or work for returned recompense supplies the loan ledger.
Beneficence, craft, and excess beyond strict justice qualify the severance as good.
Increase by a like amount or more supplies the enlarged return.

changed_reading.before: A pious donation receives a reward.
changed_reading.after: A possessed portion is deliberately severed as good capital and returned on a divinely enlarged scale.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated promises at words 6 and 8 give the loan both multiplication and forgiveness.
baseline_models.mechanism: The response settles two distinct accounts: it adds positive value and covers harmful liability. Divine appreciation makes the settlement reciprocal without reducing it to equivalence.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal recompense supplies the account-to-account response.
Multiplication supplies positive accrual on the account.
Covering fault while protecting its bearer supplies removal of liability and consequence.
Recognition and praise of benefit supply the personal acknowledgment behind the settlement.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness loosely accompanies the reward for giving.
changed_reading.after: The good loan produces a two-axis settlement: multiplied credit and protective cancellation of liability.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The multiplier is named alongside the intensive شَكُور and the restraint of حَلِيم.
baseline_models.mechanism: A slight input can show an abundant visible effect, while forbearance suspends strict or immediate equivalence. The focus therefore depicts asymmetrical responsiveness, not a hurried repayment bargain.

activation_trace.role: A finite advance supplies the small initiating input.
A little feed or rain producing a visible effect supplies disproportionate responsiveness.
Fullness and abundant yield supply the result of that responsiveness.
Repeated increase turns the visible effect into explicit multiplication.
Patient self-restraint removes pressure for immediate equivalence from the exchange.

changed_reading.before: Shakur is only a general praise-name after the promise.
changed_reading.after: Shakur and Halim define a response economy in which a slight advance can mature into abundance without strict immediate equivalence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prior sovereignty and repeated self-sufficiency block any deficit in the named recipient. The loan form instead grants the giver creditor-like dignity for returning a portion already inside divine ownership.

activation_trace.role: A returnable advance supplies the focus's borrower-lender grammar.
Possession with power of disposal establishes that the named recipient already owns the economic field.
Sovereignty scales that ownership beyond an ordinary private borrower.
Independence and freedom from need block a deficit-based account of the borrowing image.
Sufficiency reinforces that the transfer benefits the giver rather than supplying the recipient.

structural_cues: 64:1 assigns dominion to Allah, 64:6 repeats self-sufficiency, and 64:17 moves Allah from grammatical recipient to answering subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sovereign ownership, self-sufficiency, and loan grammar; I infer that their collision reverses the ordinary need relation for the giver's benefit. A live alternative is that they only guard a conventional reward metaphor from literalization.

changed_reading.before: The verse pictures God primarily as a borrower who needs an advance.
changed_reading.after: The borrower form reverses ownership for the giver's sake: one returns part of what the sovereign owns yet is credited as lender, with no divine need implied.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier scene of final underpricing and missed value makes present outflow a valuation test. Multiplication restores and exceeds visible value, while forgiveness covers the giver's negative account, so the loan is an anti-loss settlement on both sides of the ledger.

activation_trace.role: The returnable advance supplies the transaction whose value is being reassessed.
Being shortchanged in a transaction supplies the danger of judging present outflow as loss.
Missing value through inattention supplies the delayed recognition of the better bargain.
Erasing fault by covering it anticipates the liability-removal half of the focus settlement.
Multiplication supplies the positive correction to apparent present loss.
Protective covering supplies the negative-account correction.

structural_cues: 64:9 already pairs righteous work with covered wrongs and lasting gain; 64:17 compresses that pair into multiplication and forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transaction loss, missed value, expiation, and the focus's two promises; I infer a final revaluation arrow from apparent loss to net gain. The live alternative is a thematic echo without a single ledger mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The loan is locally generous but economically appears as present depletion.
changed_reading.after: The loan deliberately accepts apparent present underpricing so that final valuation both multiplies credit and removes debit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding release sequence activates the focus branch in which injured honor and renounced retaliation can earn recompense. A good loan may therefore include surrendering a live interpersonal claim, especially within kinship, not only transferring money.

activation_trace.role: Injury to honor and foregoing counter-payment open a non-monetary claim as lendable value.
Leaving punishment and erasing fault supplies the act of relinquishing an enforceable claim.
Graceful turning away from fault supplies the social manner of that relinquishment.
Human and divine protective covering place released claims in a reciprocal sequence.
Kinship locates the claim-release mechanism inside close family relations.
The focus promise returns protective covering for the released claim.

structural_cues: 64:14 moves from household danger through pardon, turning aside, and forgiveness; 64:17 then coordinates multiplication with forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a loan branch about injured honor and foregone requital plus a household release sequence; I infer that a surrendered claim can function as principal. The live alternative is that monetary spending remains exclusive and the release sequence only shapes its ethos.

changed_reading.before: A good loan is exclusively a transfer of money or material aid.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can also be a retaliatory or reputational claim surrendered to God, answered by divine covering rather than human counter-payment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wealth is first named as an assay, then spending confronts the self's eager withholding, and only then becomes a good loan. The goodness thus marks a revealed and repaired relation to possession as well as the outward quality of the gift.

activation_trace.role: Cutting away a portion supplies the decisive operation performed on possession.
Beneficent action supplies the positive quality disclosed by the operation.
Acquiring and accumulating wealth supplies the material under examination.
Assaying metal and persons turns possession into a test that reveals quality.
Compensation for work supplies the declared outcome beyond the tested wealth.
Eager withholding identifies the internal impurity exposed by the assay.

structural_cues: 64:15 names wealth as trial and reward with God; 64:16 makes spending the answer and self-stinginess the obstacle; 64:17 recasts that spending as loan.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wealth, assay, compensation, withholding, and cutting; I infer that severance is the assay action and hasan records its ethical result. A live alternative is that hasan qualifies only the gift's external form.

changed_reading.before: Hasan describes only the donated object or act as good.
changed_reading.after: Hasan also records an assay result: cutting wealth loose exposes and reforms the giver's possessive relation to it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Spending is both disappearance and a passage with an outlet, while stinginess blocks departure. The focus's cutting and multiplication convert expenditure from terminal loss into controlled circulation through an unseen return path.

activation_trace.role: Cutting supplies release from the giver's stock.
Departure and exhaustion supply the giver's immediate experience of expenditure.
A traversable tunnel with an outlet recasts departure as passage rather than annihilation.
A visible entrance with a hidden exit supplies the unseen segment of the return route.
Eager withholding supplies the blockage that prevents entry into circulation.
Multiplication supplies the enlarged emergence from the passage.

structural_cues: The sequence spend, benefit yourselves, be protected from self-withholding, succeed, then lend and be multiplied makes release the operative hinge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outflow, a tunnel with hidden exit, withholding, cutting, and multiplication; I infer a circulation arrow from release through hidden passage to enlarged return. The live alternative is ordinary expenditure followed by separately promised reward.

changed_reading.before: Expenditure leaves the giver's possession and is later compensated from outside the act.
changed_reading.after: The good loan is the expenditure itself understood as passage: what exits possession enters a hidden route and re-emerges multiplied.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing unseen-seen pair extends appraisal beyond public visibility. A loan can disappear from social notice yet remain present to divine knowledge, and Shakur turns a slight hidden input into a witnessed effect.

activation_trace.role: The advanced act supplies the value that can leave the giver's visible control.
A small input whose effect becomes evident supplies the transition from hidden act to visible result.
Concealment from eyes supplies the socially unseen side of the gift.
Presence with direct witnessing supplies complete appraisal despite social concealment.
A manifest sign supplies the eventual evidence of the hidden loan's effect.

structural_cues: 64:18 immediately follows the promise and pairs unseen with witnessed rather than ending at private intention alone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hiddenness, witnessing, manifest sign, and responsive effect; I infer that divine appraisal carries a concealed deed into visible consequence. A live alternative is that the closing names only general omniscience without specifying the loan's visibility path.

changed_reading.before: The reward promise does not alter the social visibility of giving.
changed_reading.after: The loan need not be publicly legible: it remains fully witnessed and may become visible only through the effect produced by divine appreciation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses finance into cultivation through material branches. It remains valid because focus cutting, multiplication, and responsive growth anchor every stage while 64:16 supplies retained ground and plowing; render it only as a material analogy, not as a replacement definition of loan.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus sequence joins a cut-off loan, multiplication, and the highly responsive Shakur.

activation_trace.role: Cutting supplies the opening operation on a retained stock or surface.
Ground that holds back its flood supplies the image of sterile retention.
Splitting and cutting supply the breach that makes retained ground productive.
The plowman opening earth converts cutting into cultivation.
A little rain producing greenness supplies high response to a slight released input.
Fresh shoots supply the visible regenerative result.
Increase by repeated likeness supplies multiplication of the growth.

changed_reading.before: The loan is an abstract credit transaction.
changed_reading.after: As a contained cultivation analogy, the loan is a cut opened in hoarded ground through which a slight released input germinates into multiplied visible growth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus uses loan-to-God language while one qard branch concerns venture capital. It remains anchored through focus capital and multiplication plus 64:13 entrustment; qualify it as a control-transfer analogy and never imply divine need, shared ownership, or commercial uncertainty.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's qard wording and guaranteed multiplication permit a cautious capital-management reading.

activation_trace.role: Capital handed over for trade and profit supplies the venture structure.
Surrendering management to another supplies transfer of control.
Reliance supplies the giver's posture during the unseen interval.
One who manages sufficiently and preserves supplies the trusted-management side of the analogy.
Self-sufficiency blocks the analogy from implying that God needs outside capital.
Multiplication supplies the return beyond principal.

changed_reading.before: The lender retains a simple creditor expectation after giving.
changed_reading.after: As a cautious venture analogy, the giver releases control of capital into trusted management and receives more than principal, while divine self-sufficiency prevents a literal partnership reading.

strongest_changes: Sovereignty and self-sufficiency reverse the ordinary borrower-need relation.
The preceding household release sequence opens a live non-monetary reading in which a retaliatory claim is lent by being surrendered.
Wealth-as-assay and self-withholding move hasan from object quality to the giver's tested relation with possession.
Spending branches recast apparent disappearance as passage through a hidden outlet into multiplied return.
summary.what_was_special: The focus preserved several mechanisms at once: two-account settlement, ownership reversal, surrendered social claims, anti-loss revaluation, and branch-driven circulation. The cultivation and venture readings remain contained because their unusual material images produce coherent changed readings without displacing the ordinary loan sense.
remaining_uncertainties: The extension from monetary lending to relinquished interpersonal claims is directly branch-activated but still exploratory.
The hydraulic and cultivation mechanisms are coherent cross-domain analogies rather than secure lexical paraphrases.
The venture-capital branch may illuminate transfer of control, but its later legal specificity should not be imported wholesale.
